primary_estimand.per_training_seed: average U over five fixed evaluation seeds, then equal-weight mean of log(U_IPPO/U_IPPO-P) over H1,H2,H3

primary_test.population: ten new independent training seeds 47-56 only
primary_test.decision_rule: positive effect and exact two-sided p < 0.05

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap over training seeds

secondary_analyses: per-scenario H1/H2/H3 effects on new seeds
descriptive pooled 15-seed effect using pilot plus confirmation seeds
completion rates, teleport counts, and demand conservation checks
exclusions: No completed seed may be excluded based on performance. Exclude only protocol-invalid or corrupted tasks, report reason, and rerun the same seed before unblinding aggregate results.
stopping_rule: Run all 60 planned tasks; no interim efficacy stopping.
